item.description:
Xiaofu Ju - Mist Without

Xiaofu Ju, piano
Cover
Published: 2026
File Size: 0.98 Gb
FLAC 24-bit/96kHz

TRACKLIST:
01. Janáček: In the Mists, JW VIII/22: I. Andante (03:26)
02. Janáček: In the Mists, JW VIII/22: II. Molto adagio (04:30)
03. Janáček: In the Mists, JW VIII/22: III. Andantino (02:19)
04. Janáček: In the Mists, JW VIII/22: IV. Presto (04:20)
05. Janáček: Piano Sonata 1.X.1905, JW VIII/19 "From the Street": I. Foreboding (06:04)
06. Janáček: Piano Sonata 1.X.1905, JW VIII/19 "From the Street": II. Death (07:18)
07. Ravel: Gaspard de la nuit, M. 55: I. Ondine (06:22)
08. Ravel: Gaspard de la nuit, M. 55: II. Le Gibet (05:56)
09. Ravel: Gaspard de la nuit, M. 55: III. Scarbo (09:06)
10. Mozart: Requiem, K. 626: Lacrimosa (Arr. Xiaofu for Piano) (04:37)
11. Dowland: In Darkness Let Me Dwell (Arr. Xiaofu for Piano) (03:25)
12. Scriabin: Piano Sonata No. 7, Op. 64 "White Mass" (11:01)

In the Chinese context, "without" refers to the world beyond oneself, while "mist" refers to a state of search, confusion of thoughts, and blurred reality. The musician himself describes the result as "audible obscurity": clarity persists even in uncertainty, and through silence and resonance, the contours of the inner world appear. The album is conceived not as a set of individual pieces, but as a holistic immersion: the listener goes through images of fog, night, ghosts, sorrow and darkness in order to reach a moment of clear silence at the end. Different styles and eras are intertwined in music, from Central European modernism and Russian mysticism to French Impressionism. There is a tension between tradition and modernity, between written text and improvisation, personal narrative and universal emotions.

Digital Release Deutsche Grammophon China
